description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into a Notion database. Each row is matched against existing pages by key_property; matches are updated, misses are inserted. Property values are serialized based on the database's schema, retrieved from the Notion API at materialize time.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Notion database page (upserted via key_property).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata. No downstream data -- write side effect lands in Notion.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with source.

source.label: Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql/csv/inline). Mutually exclusive with upstream_asset_key.

key_property.label: Key Property
key_property.description: Notion property name that uniquely identifies a row (usually the title property). Rows are matched to existing Notion pages by this property's value.

key_column.label: Key Column
key_column.description: Upstream DataFrame column holding the value that matches key_property.

delete_missing.label: Delete Missing
delete_missing.description: If true, archive Notion pages whose key value is NOT in the upstream DataFrame.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows to process per run (safety cap).

name: Notion Database Upsert
